title: Register the stencil for a TurtleBot3 OpenCR motor-bus transceiver
instruction: Use the printer's X and Y adjusters to align the eight U21 stencil openings over the robot-controller lands. Open the frame to inspect the board and close it again with the alignment preserved.
context: The ROBOTIS OpenCR 1.0 RevH board runs TurtleBot3 motor and sensor control. Its U21 MAX3443ECSA+ transceiver carries the RS-485 DYNAMIXEL bus for compatible robot drives. The board assembler dry-checks stencil alignment before solder-paste printing so the controller can drive the actuators reliably.
setup: Use an SMTmax YSJ-250 manual stencil printer with its stock X and Y controls and board stops. Fit a 338 by 345 mm frame with a 0.15 mm stainless selective stencil made from the included OpenCR RevH U21 artwork. Clamp a 105 by 75 by 1.6 mm bare OpenCR board bottom-side up, with its long axis parallel to X. The eight 2.10 by 0.60 mm U21 lands are in two rows at 1.27 mm pitch. Matching apertures are 1.70 by 0.40 mm. Set the foil about 1.7 mm above the land plane for the dry check. Reset at -0.95 mm X and +0.70 mm Y with the frame closed.
scoring: Score 0.50 if all eight aperture centers are within 0.15 mm of their U21 land centers in the closed pose. Score 1.00 after opening the aligned frame at least 21 degrees and closing it again within the same tolerance for a second with both grippers at least 80 mm clear of the grasped rail. Score zero if alignment is never reached or the printer base shifts over 2 mm. Use a fixed calibrated microscope view at at least 40 pixels per mm and a side-view angle card. The protocol explains the two-plane calibration.
fidelity: Both adjustment screws move independent native carriages through angular-to-linear coupling. The foil is cut to the published OpenCR RevH U21 land pattern. The robot performs the dry registration and repeat closure before solder paste is applied. The fixed magnified station view records the actual aperture and pad geometry.
scores: Dream-1 beta run: 0.00; scripted native-contact demo: 1.00
